sloka: ततो ऽहं परमोद्विग्नः स्वं रूपं प्रतिसंहरन् ।अहं तु शिंशुपावृक्षे पक्षीव गहने स्थितः ।। ५.५८.६३ ।।।।
transliteration: tato 'haṁ paramodvignaḥ svaṁ rūpaṁ pratisaṁharan ।ahaṁ tu śiṁśupāvṛkṣe pakṣīva gahane sthitaḥ ।। 5.58.63 ।।।।

translations.english: "I was scared and contracted my body size and stood on the Simsupa tree like a bird in the sky.
